# watchpoint_status_page (Data Source)

Looks up a single status page by name within the tenant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "watchpoint_status_page" "example" {
  name = "Public Status"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the status page to look up (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Status page ID.
- `is_published` (Boolean) Whether the page is published.
- `slug` (String) Per-tenant unique slug.
- `visibility` (String) Page visibility (e.g. `Public`, `Private`).
